entries.title: Matthew 3:1
segments: ¶Now in those days comes John the baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

entries.title: Matthew 3:2
segments: and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn nigh.

entries.title: Matthew 3:3
segments: For this is he who has been spoken of through Esaias the prophet, saying, Voice of him that crieth in the wilderness: prepare ye the way of [the] Lord, make straight his paths.

entries.title: Matthew 3:4
segments: And John himself had his garment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins, and his nourishment was locusts and wild honey.

entries.title: Matthew 3:5
segments: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the country round the Jordan,

entries.title: Matthew 3:6
segments: and were baptised by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Matthew 3:7
segments: ¶But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of vipers, who has forewarned you to flee from the coming wrath?

entries.title: Matthew 3:8
segments: Produce therefore fruit worthy of repentance.

entries.title: Matthew 3:9
segments: And do not think to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for [our] father; for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 3:10
segments: And already the axe is applied to the root of the trees; every tree therefore not producing good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

entries.title: Matthew 3:11
segments: *I* indeed baptise you with water to repentance, but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not fit to bear; *he* shall baptise you with [the] Holy Spirit and fire;

entries.title: Matthew 3:12
segments: whose winnowing fan [is] in his hand, and he shall thoroughly purge his threshing-floor, and shall gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

entries.title: Matthew 3:13
segments: ¶Then comes Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptised of him;

entries.title: Matthew 3:14
segments: but John urgently forbad him, saying, *I* have need to be baptised of thee; and comest *thou* to me?

entries.title: Matthew 3:15
segments: But Jesus answering said to him, Suffer [it] now; for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffers him.

entries.title: Matthew 3:16
segments: And Jesus, having been baptised, went up straightway from the water, and lo, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him:

entries.title: Matthew 3:17
segments: and behold, a voice out of the heavens saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I have found my delight.
